decisions.reason: A perfect binder is a core item in a print-finishing distributor's range, and distributors usually keep such models until the manufacturer replaces them, though missing website evidence after 2019 and the pandemic-hit print market add some risk.
The fully automatic perfect binder serves higher-volume print shops, which complements the range and justifies keeping it despite weak demand in commercial print.
An inline and nearline booklet maker fits the trend toward integrated digital print finishing, so it likely remains a relevant offering for the distributor.
